experiment_name: canonical 1D ResNet with statistical input augmentation

validation.epoch_selection: median of the five fold best epochs (round half up)
validation.target_use: load and evaluate Batches 2-10 only after source-only selection and final-model freezing

augmentation.schedule: fixed once per training fold and once for final source fit
augmentation.partner_sampling: uniform among same-class non-self source-training samples; replacement across anchors allowed
augmentation.label: preserve anchor gas label

implementation_assumptions.standard_scaler: StandardScaler is fit on each Batch 1 training fold, and on all Batch 1 for final fitting.
implementation_assumptions.augmentation_sampling: The executable sampling details and fixed one-view schedule are project assumptions where the paper is unspecified.
implementation_assumptions.final_epoch_rule: The final source model uses the round-half-up median of the five source-fold selected epochs, matching canonical B0.
implementation_assumptions.training_order: Original and augmented examples are concatenated into one training dataset and jointly shuffled each epoch.
implementation_assumptions.interpretation: A1 is statistical input augmentation based on the paper's equations; it is not claimed to simulate physical sensor drift.
